description: You are an industrial ecologist conducting an uncertainty analysis for a carbon footprint study of electricity generation. Using openLCA and the USLCI database at ~/LCA_Imports/uslci_database.zip (LCIA methods at ~/LCA_Imports/lcia_methods.zip), perform a Monte Carlo simulation to quantify uncertainty in the global warming potential (GWP) of coal-fired electricity generation. You must: (1) import the database and LCIA methods, (2) locate a coal electricity generation process in the USLCI database and build a product system for it, (3) define at least 3 process input parameters with uncertainty distributions (e.g., log-normal or normal distributions for emission factors or energy inputs), (4) run a Monte Carlo simulation with at least 500 iterations using GWP as the impact indicator, and (5) export the uncertainty analysis results — including the mean GWP value, standard deviation, and 95% confidence interval — to ~/LCA_Results/monte_carlo_results.csv.
